channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Yang Hansen | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Yang Hansen from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Micah Nori on Hansen Yang, Yang Hansen
item.description:
Micah Nori on Hansen Yang:

“I think thathe has done a very good job and his showing has been very well. I think that is where we have the luxury of because with what we are going to do rotation wise and how we are going to play, if we are fully healthy, I don’t know,it may be a spot here and there, maybe a couple bigs, Robert or Donovan get into foul trouble and those type of things and the matchup. So by any means, it is not like we are just counting Hansen out, but if there is an opportunity that arises, we feel very comfortable putting him in the basketball game.”

Micah Nori on Hansen Yang, Yang Hansen, Oct 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Yang Hansen
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Joe Cronin on Yang Hansen:

“I thought he had a really promising offseason. He was really good in Summer League and played really well with the Chinese national team. Even before that, he had some good moments with the Remix.”

Joe Cronin on Yang Hansen, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Yang Hansen
item.description:
Jrue Holiday on Yang Hansen:

“He’s been a superstar. He’s been hooping. We were talking about it earlier, how much media he’s had in Vegas. He deserves it. He’s been doing his thing. I’m not sure anybody saw how well he would play, but he’s been playing well. I’m excited.”

Jrue Holiday on Yang Hansen, Jul 29, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Yang Hansen
item.description:
' @trailblazers GM Joe Cronin on 7-2, 260-pound draft pick Yang Hansen:

“Yang is mature physically already. He is strong, firm and sturdy and can withstand the strength of the NBA guys. It is extremely difficult to find a young player of that stature with this skill set. Big men who can do all the things he can do typically succeed in our league. It might take him a little time, but as he figures out the speed and pace of our game, I wouldn’t put a ceiling on him. He is that talented.”

Joe Cronin on Yang Hansen, Jun 26, 2025. Source: x.com.
